title: BlackLanturn Build 1.1.27
summary: The Installer now updates with the build, keeping your complete setup.

sections.heading: One BlackLanturn update
bullets: The Installer, included add-ons and tested BlackLanturn patches update together.
Once Build 1.1.27 and Installer 1.0.32 are installed, future build updates no longer require a separate Installer update through the repository.

sections.heading: Protected update and recovery
bullets: Updates are staged and checked before replacing code. Interrupted Installer updates can recover when BlackLanturn starts.
Close and reopen Kodi after updating to load the complete new version.

sections.heading: Keep your complete setup
bullets: Your playback settings, authorizations, watched progress, sources, favourites and other saved data stay in place.
Other add-ons you installed stay untouched; platform playback fixes remain included.
